OpenAI Group PBC today announced the launch of GPT-6.2 Astra, a new frontier artificial intelligence model for complex professional work that is claimed to outperform its predecessor at less than a third of the cost, along with an updated version of its everyday model, GPT-6.2 Sol. The new models are aimed at businesses and developers […]
